title: Application Principles Catalogue
description: Catalogue of architecture principles for the Application architecture domain — vendor-neutral guidelines that shape design decisions. Aligned to TOGAF Architecture Principles (Name, Statement, Rationale, Implications).

meta.description: The guiding principles that shape how Application architecture decisions are made.
purpose: Establishes consistent criteria for evaluating build, buy, and extend decisions
Prevents fragmentation of the application portfolio by establishing preferred patterns
Provides guidance on architecture qualities such as modularity, coupling, and resilience
Enables automated analysis of proposed applications against established principles
Creates shared expectations between application architects, engineers, and product teams

$schema.description: URN of the schema this instance conforms to (this file's $id).

statement.description: The principle, stated as a directive

rationale.description: Why this principle exists — the underlying motivation

implications.description: Consequences for design and decision-making if this principle is adopted
